fieldValues.title: Every governing decision names an indicator
fieldValues.decision_question: How do we know a governing decision works?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's walk of 2026-10-11 after session srs-programme#100; awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Every governing decision names how we will know it works, as a reusable indicator that is measured each cycle.
fieldValues.rationale: A decision without a measure cannot be reviewed on evidence. Indicators are records, reused across decisions, not prose repeated in each.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When the indicators measured over several cycles have not led to one decision being acted on or revised.
